'''Malthee''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]]. After the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] refused to give in to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] demands to increase food production and request for more access to Kinyen, the Empire [[Massacre at Malthee|bombarded]] the heavily populated city, leaving a crater in its place. The Gran built a [[Doellinism/Legends|Doellinist]] temple and a memorial on the site of the crater.<ref name="SoR" />

[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agents secretly met with Doellinist priests in the ruins of Malthee.<ref name="SoR" />
